name: true-canadian-maps
description: True Canadian Maps: style, mark up, publish and embed interactive maps. Self-hostable or hosted SaaS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n studio,worker,delivery -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter @tcm/studio dev" "pnpm --filter @tcm/worker dev" "pnpm dev:delivery"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist .next .turbo && rm -rf node_modules
